title: ummm, undecided
text:
ummm, undecided. Have you ever had a long time crush on someone you have never actually met but you frequently see on your way to work or class etc? then one day, you actually meet and have a small conversation with that person - you know that feeling you get as your attraction to them lessens more and more as you learn more about them? yeah, its kind of like that with this heater.
the heater is attractive. ive had it a week now and it certainly has caught the attention of visitors - great conversation starter. It definitely feels warmer in the room while it is on.. strong heat flow but only comes out one small vent located at the top of the unit . the unit is heavier than I expected and it is much wider than I realized so if you hang it, it will stick out quite a bit from the wall. Perhaps it is just me but I dont really get the “ crystals” thing - I think they cheapen the look of the heater - crystals give it a “swap meet” kind of look. I know I can buy a much better quality heater for the same price (about $150) . It wont be as attractive perhaps but like people, beauty does not last forever and then what are you left with? I have yet to decide if the heater stays or if I will be returning it. If it stays, I am going to have to buy a second heater ( small and cheap ) to help this heater heat the room more efficiently. im not sure how this item qualifies as touch screen? great for small rooms with low ceilings. if your ceilings are high, this wont work as well. if you lose the remote control you are not screwed, you can still operate the heater manually.

product_metadata.title: LifePlus Electric Fireplace Heater, 26 Inch Glass Fireplace Heater with Wall Mounted and Freestanding, Adjustable 10 Flame LED Colors, Log & Crystal Hearth Options, Remote Control, 12H Timer
features: REMOTE ADJUSTABLE HEAT TEMPERATURES – Using either the included remote control or the built-in LED control panel, you can easily adjust and set the temperature of our electric fireplace heater between 59°F to 95°F to give you perfect comfort in any room. You can also heat your home overnight without risk or worry thanks to the built in 12-hour timer.

TEN GORGEOUS COLOR OPTIONS – Once set up in the room of your choice, our fireplace Electric Heater can help set the perfect ambiance thanks to being able to set it between 10 color options for the illumination of the flames. Letting you choose from the base realistic wooden fire log aesthetic or a burning crystal aesthetic, both in a variety of dazzling colors.

MULTIPLE MOUNTING METHODS – Whether you’re in a house or apartment, this fireplace space heater is a perfect fit for any home with its two installation methods. Being wall mounted makes it a beautiful and cozy fixture that’s simple to install, while its freestanding tabletop mounting method makes it the perfect portable room heater to take and use anywhere in your home.

DESIGNED FOR SAFETY – This wall mounted and freestanding electric fireplace is designed with an intelligent overheat safety function that automatically shuts it off when reaching a certain internal temperature. Plus, by holding the “up” and “down” buttons for 3 seconds you can engage the child safety lock to ensure your children don’t accidentally turn it on.

MODERN HOME DÉCOR – With the multiple color options to choose from and our wall mounted electric fireplace’s sleek, compact, and modern design, it makes for a gorgeous piece of home décor is sure to become a main talking piece among guests whether it’s mounted in your living room, kitchen, study, office, or bedroom.
